dialogues.speaker: Soncoyoc
dialogues.text: Price cut, price cut! Once they're gone, I'm gone! It's now or never, so don't miss out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What could you be selling in a place like this?

dialogues.speaker: Soncoyoc
dialogues.text: Why so many questions? Oh, you're new around here, aren't you? In that case, I don't think you need what I'm selling right now. When the time comes that you do, you'll know what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Soncoyoc
dialogues.text: Price cut, price cut! Once they're gone, I'm gone! It's now or never, so don't miss out!

choices.text: I heard I could get my hands on some special potions here...

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: Pretty well-informed, aren't you? Go on then, tell me what you need.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'd like one of those potions that almost killed Sumac.

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: ...Sumac? Oh, I remember now. But wait a sec... What do you mean she almost died? And what does it have to do with my potions?

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: You're not trying to extort me, are you? I've sold so many potions now I've lost count, yet in all this time, I've never had anyone make complaints or kick up trouble before — only repeat customers!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You sure it's not because the ones who would've done so all ended up having little "accidents"?

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: Huh, are you seriously challenging me? My reputation means everything! I'll even give you the potion formula for free. You find anything fishy about it — anything at all — just come find me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And... how would I do that if something had already happened to me?

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: I'm offering you the formula for free, and you want me to cough up Mora too? You sure know how to play the game, huh?

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: It's not like I'm in anyone's way, is it? Besides, selling's never a problem for someone with as solid a reputation as mine.

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: Not gonna lie though. Working the graveyard shift day after day is tough stuff. One of these days, I'll get a message to Hawka asking him to send someone else to replace me.

choices.text: So the things you sell here are all completely legit, yeah?

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: Yes, and why wouldn't they be? I sell invigorating potions for people and delicious Saurus crackers for Saurians — all one hundred and ten percent above board.

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: Aside from these finished products, I also sell alchemical materials. We've got everything from Butterfly Wings to Loach Pearls, so whatever you need, just ask — there's nothing we can't get our hands on.

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: Oh, except, if you're into the same kind of stuff as Ixtelo, I don't wanna hear about it.

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: Though we might seem shady ourselves, that guy's "gem" dealings... well, even we won't turn a blind eye there.

response.speaker: Soncoyoc
response.text: Take care.
